Reyee RG-RAP52-OD Wi-Fi 5 AC1300 Outdoor Access Point – High-Speed, Weatherproof, and Mesh-Enabled

Boost Your Outdoor Wi-Fi Coverage with Seamless Connectivity

The Reyee RG-RAP52-OD is a high-performance Wi-Fi 5 AC1300 outdoor access point, designed to deliver fast and reliable wireless connectivity for homes, villas, retail stores, and commercial spaces. With speeds up to 1267 Mbps, this compact yet powerful dual-band access point ensures strong, stable Wi-Fi signals even in harsh outdoor environments.

Key Features:

  • Ultra-Fast Wi-Fi 5 Performance – Supports 802.11ac Wave 2 with dual-band speeds up to 1267 Mbps
  • Advanced Outdoor Durability – IP65-rated weatherproof design for reliable performance in extreme conditions (-30°C to +70°C)
  • Flexible Installation – Supports wall or pole mounting for maximum placement flexibility
  • Detachable Antennas – Customize coverage for optimal signal strength in any location
  • Mesh & AI Roaming – Seamlessly expand your network with Reyee Mesh technology and AI-powered roaming
  • Standalone Portal – Ideal for retail businesses needing guest Wi-Fi management

Technical Specifications:

  • Wi-Fi Protocol: 802.11ac Wave 2, dual-band (2.4 GHz & 5 GHz)
  • Speed: 1267 Mbps (2×2 MIMO on both 2.4 GHz & 5 GHz)
  • Port: 1 x Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000Base-T)
  • Max Clients: 110 devices (recommended: 96)
  • Power Supply: IEEE 802.3af PoE or 24V Passive PoE
  • Power Consumption: 14W
  • Size: 220 mm × 50 mm × 35.7 mm (8.66 in × 1.97 in × 1.41 in)
  • Weight: ≤ 0.4 kg
  • Certifications: CE, RoHS
  • Warranty: 1 Years
